description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for managing sandbox filesystem paths and mounts, including parsing bind mounts, building mount configurations, resolving paths with mounts, and utility functions for path handling within a sandbox environment.

classes.name: SandboxFsMount
classes.description: Type representing a filesystem mount point in the sandbox, including host and container roots, writability, and source type.

classes.name: SandboxResolvedFsPath
classes.description: Type representing a resolved filesystem path within the sandbox, including host path, container path, relative path, and writability.

methods.name: parseSandboxBindMount
methods.description: Parses a bind mount specification string into a ParsedBindMount object, determining host and container roots and writability.

methods.name: buildSandboxFsMounts
methods.description: Builds an array of filesystem mounts for a given sandbox context, including workspace, agent, and bind mounts.

methods.name: resolveSandboxFsPathWithMounts
methods.description: Resolves a given file path within the sandbox, considering mounts and path normalization, returning host and container paths.
